chunk_text: ﻿HR Leave Policy Employees are eligible for 18 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be submitted at least 5 working days in advance through the HR portal. Sick leave is allowed up to 10 days per year. For sick leave beyond 2 consecutive days, a medical certificate is required. Maternity leave and paternity leave are provided as per company policy and local labor laws. Employees must receive manager approval before taking planned leave.

﻿Laptop Return Policy Employees must return company laptops within 3 working days after resignation, termination, or project completion. The laptop, charger, access card, and any company-provided accessories must be returned to the IT asset team. If the laptop is damaged or not returned, the recovery amount may be adjusted from the final settlement. IT team must verify the asset condition and update the asset management system.

﻿Purchase Order Approval SOP Purchase orders up to ,000 require department manager approval. Purchase orders between ,001 and ,000 require approval from the finance manager. Purchase orders above ,000 require CFO approval. Emergency purchases must be documented with business justification and reviewed within 7 working days.

﻿Travel Reimbursement Policy Employees travelling for business purposes can claim reimbursement for approved travel expenses. Domestic travel meal reimbursement is limited to per day. International travel meal reimbursement is limited to per day. Hotel reimbursement must be supported by original invoices. All travel claims must be submitted within 15 days after trip completion.

﻿Workplace Safety Manual Employees must wear required personal protective equipment while entering the manufacturing area. Machine maintenance must be performed only by authorized technicians. Before maintenance work starts, lockout and tagout procedures must be followed. Any workplace incident must be reported to the safety officer within 24 hours. Safety audits must be conducted every month.
